title: Plant Manager
text:
**Please Note: This position's start date is January 11th 2027.**

**Job Description**

Are you an ambitious operations leader, shift supervisor, or production lead looking to take the next major step in your career?

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on **Plant Manager** to lead the daily operations of our production, packaging, fulfillment, receiving, inventory, and warehouse functions. Reporting directly to the VP of Product + Logistics, you will be responsible for ensuring our product moves safely, accurately, and efficiently through the business.

As a small but rapidly growing company, we need a "systems builder" who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves on the floor. Because we are a tight-knit team, we are deeply committed to your professional development. If you have an outstanding track record of leadership and team-building, but have gaps in specific technical areas—such as advanced food safety or warehouse software—we are fully prepared to invest in your training and certifications to help you bridge those gaps.

**Why This Role is a Unique Growth Opportunity**

* **Direct Mentorship:** Work hand-in-hand with our VP of Product + Logistics to learn the strategic side of supply chain, budgeting, and operations.
* **Professional Development Fund:** If your food safety background is solid but not yet at a master level, we will fund and support your path to official HACCP, PCQI, or advanced food safety certifications.
* **Ownership & Impact:** You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will design and implement the systems (from WMS architecture to preventive maintenance) that will power our brand's next phase of growth.

**Key Responsibilities1. Production Planning & Preventive Maintenance**

* **Master Production Scheduling:** Move us from day-to-day planning to proactive operational excellence. You will own the Master Production Schedule (MPS), using sales forecasts, historical data, and retail demands to plan batch runs weeks in advance.
* **Production Oversight:** Manage the physical processing, grinding, sifting, kitting, labeling, and sealing of our artisan products.
* **Preventive Maintenance (PM):** Design and enforce a strict PM calendar for our machinery (grinders, mills, sifters) to prevent costly breakdowns.

**2. Inventory Strategy & Warehouse Architecture**

* **WMS Implementation:** Lead the strategy and physical layout for our Warehouse Management System (WMS), including mapping warehouse bins, establishing min/max reorder thresholds, and training the team on barcode scanning software.
* **Inventory Flow:** Maintain strict First Expired, First Out (FEFO) rules to minimize waste and optimize physical space.
* **Stock Optimization:** Oversee regular stocktakes, resolve POS discrepancies, and manage inventory levels across our warehouse, retail storefronts, and external markets.

**3. People Leadership & Team Development**

* **Cross-Training & Training Matrices:** Build and maintain a robust "Training Matrix" so that critical roles (such as running the mill or pulling retail transfers) are never dependent on a single person.
* **Staff Development:** Direct, schedule, and coach our hourly production, fulfillment, and receiving teams.
* **Accountability:** Conduct regular performance reviews, set clear quality standards, and directly address performance issues constructively.

**4. Fulfillment, Logistics & Financial Control**

* **Fulfillment Efficiency:** Oversee omni-channel order processing (Cin7 CORE, Shopify, ShipStation) and optimize pick-and-pack times while ensuring lot traceability.
* **Operational Budgeting (OpEx):** Help protect our margins by monitoring labor cost-per-unit, tracking waste metrics, and negotiating shipping rates with carriers.
* **Sourcing:** Direct the physical organization and cost-effective purchasing of shipping materials.

**5. Food Safety, Sanitation & Compliance**

* **Compliance Administration:** Oversee facility compliance, maintain GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) logs, and lead sanitation routines.
* **Safety Training Support:** *If you do not currently hold a PCQI or advanced HACCP certification, we will provide the training and resources to get you certified within your first 90 days.*

**Qualifications**

**Note on Qualifications:** We value a proven track record of leadership, a high level of responsibility, and a growth mindset above a "perfect" resume. If you meet the core leadership requirements, we encourage you to apply!

**What You** ***Must*** **Have (Non-Negotiable):**

* **3+ years of direct people management experience**, ideally leading hourly production, fulfillment, warehouse, or retail operations teams.
* A proven track record of growing, coaching, and organizing teams, with a reputation for high emotional intelligence and clear communication.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with calm and clarity.
* A "hands-on" attitude—you love being on the floor with your team, solving physical bottlenecks, and keeping spirits high.

**What is** ***Nice-to-Have*** **(Areas We Can Help Train & Grow You In):**

* Experience in food production, CPG, or manufacturing.
* Familiarity with Shopify, ShipStation, ERPs or similar Inventory/Warehouse Management Systems.
* Existing Food Safety certifications (HACCP, PCQI, GMP compliance).
* Experience designing preventive maintenance schedules for mechanical equipment.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

**Milestone**

**Expectation**

**First 30 Days**

Learn our current workflow, build trust with the hourly team, and shadow our existing fulfillment and production flows.

**First 90 Days**

Implement the PM machinery calendar, assume ownership of scheduling, and establish your first team Training Matrix.

**First 6 Months**

Successfully lead the production capacity planning and take complete ownership of floor OpEx, including labor efficiency metrics.

**First Year**

Establish a highly cross-trained, self-sufficient team that operates with calm, efficiency, and zero reactive daily fire-fighting.

**What We Offer**

* Employer-sponsored health care plan
* Dental and Vision
* 401k matched (4%)
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and sick time
* Green Commuter Benefits
* Free On-Site Parking
* Employee Discounts (Including free new releases)

Curio Spice Co. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay: $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
